options.text: Combine fields from multiple sources on a common join key

items.stem: Why can averaging a per-row conversion rate give a wrong total rate?

options.text: The correct total rate must be recomputed from summed numerator and denominator
options.rationale: Correct: ratios should be aggregated from totals, not averaged.

options.text: Looker Studio cannot display ratios at all
options.rationale: It can display ratios; the issue is how they aggregate.
Averages are available but wrong for ratios here.

items.explanation: Correct: recompute ratios from summed totals.

items.stem: Which TWO improve a Looker Studio dashboard's usability? (Select TWO.)

options.text: Provide date-range and relevant filter controls
options.rationale: Correct: controls let viewers focus the data.

options.text: Use clear layout with sufficient colour contrast
options.rationale: Correct: clarity and contrast aid readability.

options.text: Place as many charts as possible on one page
Rely on default colours regardless of contrast

items.explanation: Correct: controls and clear, high-contrast layout help usability.
